_comment: Example registry. Copy to tools/benchmark_devices.json (git-ignored) and replace each serial with your phone's `adb devices` serial (USB serial or the adb-tls mDNS name for wireless debugging). node_prefix is the first 12 hex digits of the phone's MeshLive node ID (shown in the app and logged as 'BENCHMARK call available: node=...'); the values below are placeholders. Aliases must match tools/benchmark_scope.json and tools/device_policy_registry.json; add your own aliases for other phones.
